limitations: Two initially occupied, equal-area patches; independent exponential local extinction; a specified constant recolonization rate; no environmental catastrophe correlation, demography or movement cost. Complete text of several directly relevant older reserve-design studies was not available.
title: A one-crossing fragmentation law and a universal rescue-gap for fixed-area reserves
